ghi_chu: So lieu vong 2 (11/09/2026), da qua ban sua liem chinh 12/09/2026. Moi con so do that; cot nguon ghi file sinh ra. Da tu kiem chung: 11 fold roi nhau, 22 chu the moi nguoi 1 lan, khong trung PhysioNet; tom tat khop tinh lai tung chu so; sample_efficiency khong co test trung train.

SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.1_con_so_chinh_cinc: DA SUA. Ban cu ghi 'con so CinC phai bao la 69,31' -- DA RUT: 69,31 do tren mau 10 ban ghi. Tren DU 75 ban ghi, quy tac PSD mu nhan cho 79,40 (mo hinh 22 chu the) va 71,21 (mo hinh 5 chu the). Luan diem ve LIEM CHINH van dung va con manh hon: kenh 0 co dinh la lua chon HAU KIEM, va tren du 75 ban ghi no chi dat 69,33 -- tuc KEM quy tac PSD mu nhan 10,07 diem, la quy tac TE NHAT trong bon. Con so 90,34 tren mau 10 khong nhung khong hop le ve liem chinh ma con SAI VE SU KIEN.
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.2_quy_tac_chon_kenh_khong_chuyen_mien: DA SUA. Trong mien quy tac PSD kem oracle 0,02-1,90 diem (PhysioNet 0,02; B2 0,66; B1 1,90). Ngoai mien (CinC): con so cu '22,33 diem' DA BI RUT (do tren mau 10). Tren du 75 ban ghi khoang cach PSD den oracle la 7,47 diem (PSD 79,40 so voi oracle 86,87). Ket luan dinh tinh khong doi: quy tac chon kenh, chu khong chi bo do, la thu khong chuyen mien hoan toan -- nhung do lon that nho hon nhieu so voi bao cao cu.
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.3_thong_ke: Voi n=5 chu the, p hai phia nho nhat cua Wilcoxon hang co dau chinh xac la 2/2^5 = 0,0625 -> KHONG so sanh nao tren ADFECGDB dat p<0,05 o muc chu the. Moi p tren ADFECGDB (1,9e-6; 5,7e-6; 0,0000) la san pham gia lap tren 20-60 hang (ban ghi x kenh x seed) va da bi bo. Xem analysis/STATS.md va analysis/stats_results.json.
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.4_kien_truc: Tuyen bo '8 kien truc khong phan biet duoc' da rut lai. TOST bien 1,0 diem: 0/7 kien truc tuong duong, 6/7 khong ket luan duoc. cnn_m KEM HON 2,95 diem (KTC 90% [-4,55; -1,47]); cnn_l HON 0,73 diem (KTC 90% [0,18; 1,22]).
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.5_cinc_10_tren_75: DA HOAN THANH 12/09/2026. Ca hai bien the da chay: 75 ban ghi (PSD m22 = 79,40) va 68 ban ghi (loai a33, a38, a47, a52, a54, a71, a74 -- PSD m22 = 80,70). Quy tac loai da khai bao TRUOC khi chay. Nguon: benchmark_dpss/eval_cinc75.json.
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.6_auroc_cong_tu_choi: AUROC 0,929 phan lon la hieu ung GIUA ban ghi (5/10 ban ghi khong co doan xau). AUROC TRONG ban ghi = 0,721 [0,517; 0,898] moi la con so dung cho lam sang.
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.nguon_KTC: analysis/boot_ci_table1.py -> analysis/boot_ci_table1.json (bootstrap cum, 10000 lan, seed 0; tai lap dung KTC cua analysis/stats_results.json cho cinc lead0)
SUA_LIEM_CHINH_2026_09_12.0_CANH_BAO_CAP_NHAT_VONG_4: DA RUT 12/09/2026 -- moi con so CinC 2013 trong muc nay do tren MAU 10/75 BAN GHI va bi lech CA HAI CHIEU. So chinh hien hanh la PSD mu nhan tren DU 75 ban ghi = 79,40 (benchmark_dpss/eval_cinc75.json; xem survey/facts_phase3.json muc B_cinc75). Cac gia tri tho duoi day duoc GIU LAI lam ho so lich su, KHONG duoc trich dan nhu ket qua.
